exceptions.reason: CVE-2026-14257 is fixed by the backports pinned per release line in package.json overrides (1.1.17, 2.1.3, 5.0.8 — each verified to carry the EXPANSION_MAX_LENGTH cap). The advisory range is the flat '<=5.0.7', so scanners keep reporting the patched 1.x/2.x builds. Forcing 5.0.8 everywhere is not possible: 5.x dropped the callable default export, so minimatch@3 and minimatch@9 throw 'expand is not a function' at runtime, and those are required by eslint, jest, and electron-builder. Every affected instance is dev-only build/lint/test tooling; the production tree is clean.

Advisory was withdrawn on 2023-02-14; it only proxied the http-cache-semantics ReDoS, which is pinned to ^4.2.0 via overrides. cacheable-request 10+ is ESM-only while its consumer got@11 is CommonJS, so the suggested bump is not installable. Dev-only: reaches the tree through electron-builder's @electron/get.
